response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_usage AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_usage - o.avg_usage AS above_overall_average FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.avg_usage ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10;
